findings.summary: The dependency-inventory redirect is shell-dependent on the two matrix legs.
findings.detail: On ubuntu the default shell is bash and `>` writes UTF-8. On windows-latest the default shell is pwsh, where `>` in PowerShell 7 writes UTF-8 without BOM, but Windows PowerShell 5.1 would write UTF-16LE. The file still lands in both cases; only the encoding differs.
findings.owner_action: If a consumer parses PIP_INVENTORY.json, pin the shell or use a Python one-liner.
